reason: A continuously open native MIDI port can be silently reassigned to another physical keyboard under the same OS name. Existing MidoLink.lost checked only presence of that name, and send/read accepted swapped-unit traffic after preflight. With a backend-supplied stable non-reusable physical unit token, guard every outgoing packet and received reply and report loss on replacement; fail closed when a present provider cannot identify the unit. Preserve read-only discovery with the currently unverified MidoBackend, whose Updater install still refuses pre-UPGRADE.

commands.phase: expected RED original exact Git MidoLink

positive loader port rename for same physical unit
read-only discovery remains when provider unavailable

hard_limits: No actual physical_id() exists in production MidoBackend. Normal native physical OTA is unsupported/fails closed before UPGRADE.
Fake unit token is not a real hardware identity or a USB descriptor attestation. USB path/name/model/version are not sufficient.
The check before sending is defense in depth but does not certify atomic USB write routing against swaps during the same send.
